objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) C6 (interface half), C11, section 4 'How A invokes a command', 'The five commands', 'How A's existing features sit on the interface', 'Minimal command adapter', section 8 bullets 2-3, follow-up row 3b. Entry name actl (D-072). (1) scripts/testiface.py <preflight|select|run|full|regression> [args]: reads tests.* from AC_ROOT/board/config.json; a null/absent key = built-in (preflight: rc 0; select/run/full: $AC_HOME/scripts/adapter-unittest.py; regression: $AC_HOME/scripts/verify.py --result $AC_TEST_OUT/result.json). Runs the command as sh -c "$cmd \"\$@\"" ac-test <args> with cwd AC_CODE_ROOT, a fresh empty AC_TEST_OUT it creates (caller may pass AC_TEST_OUT; default under <reports_dir>/t<n>/<run_id>/<phase>/ or <reports_dir>/gate/<run_id>/<phase>/), env AC_HOME AC_ROOT AC_CODE_ROOT AC_TEST_OUT AC_TEST_MODE AC_TICKET AC_RUN_ID AC_TEST_TIMEOUT; stdout+stderr captured to $AC_TEST_OUT/<command>.log (select's stdout is also returned to the caller); enforces tests.timeout_seconds.<command> (defaults 60/60/1800/3600/2700) with subprocess timeout -> rc 2 'unmeasured: timeout' (never red). Validation before returning to the gate: select rc 0 with empty stdout -> rc 2; run/full/regression rc 0 but result.json missing/invalid/schema != 1, zero ids, ids != the ids passed (run), or any fail/error row -> rc 2 with the reason on stderr; rc 86 with environment_suspect [] -> rc 2; rc 86 with rows -> 86 and the rows copied to the caller's suspect file (--suspect-file). preflight rc 86: stdout JSON list of rows is written to the suspect file; preflight other non-zero -> rc 2 'preflight itself failed'. 'actl test <command> ...' maps to it. (2) scripts/gate.sh phases on the interface, everything after the result as today: preflight first (rc 86 -> the existing env_suspect_note path: status env_suspect, no rerun, no auto-fix, one inbox page; rc 2 -> gate rc 2 'preflight itself failed', no tests run); select --mode branch fed the changed files computed exactly as gate.sh:1006-1008 today (base mode for --base): 'unmapped <file>' lines keep today's semantics byte for byte (diff_tests guard rule 1014-1023, run what mapped, exit 3, ticket_gate 3), select rc 3 -> gate rc 3 with select's stderr echoed, rc 2 -> gate rc 2; run <ids> / full; green = rc 0 and result validated; the output line 'gate: python3 -m unittest <mods>' becomes 'gate: run <ids>'; flake_rerun reruns each fail/error id via testiface run <id> flake_auto_single_runs times (each into $AC_TEST_OUT/rerun-<k>/), group rerun via run <all ids> flake_auto_group_runs times; flaky classification and the auto flaky ticket unchanged; regression via testiface regression --tag ...; status.py done --result <result.json> (--log kept as attachment).
